from PIL import Image
from collections import deque

def detect(path, dark_thresh=55, min_size=15, max_size=800):
    im = Image.open(path)
    w,h = im.size
    px = im.load()
    def g(x,y):
        p=px[x,y]
        return (p[0]+p[1]+p[2])/3
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    blobs=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if seen[y][x] or g(x,y) >= dark_thresh:
                continue
            # flood
            q=deque([(x,y)])
            seen[y][x]=True
            pts=[(x,y)]
            touch_border=False
            while q:
                cx,cy=q.popleft()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=cx+dx,cy+dy
                    if nx<0 or ny<0 or nx>=w or ny>=h:
                        touch_border=True
                        continue
                    if not seen[ny][nx] and g(nx,ny)<dark_thresh:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True
                        q.append((nx,ny))
                        pts.append((nx,ny))
            if min_size <= len(pts) <= max_size and not touch_border:
                xs=[p[0] for p in pts]; ys=[p[1] for p in pts]
                blobs.append((sum(xs)/len(xs), sum(ys)/len(ys), len(pts), min(xs), max(xs), min(ys), max(ys)))
    blobs.sort(key=lambda b: (b[1], b[0]))
    print(path, "blobs", len(blobs))
    for b in blobs:
        print(f"  cx={b[0]:.1f} cy={b[1]:.1f} n={b[2]} bbox=({b[3]}-{b[4]}, {b[5]}-{b[6]})")
    return blobs

from PIL import Image
from collections import deque

def detect(path, dark_thresh=50, min_size=20, max_size=3000):
    im = Image.open(path)
    w,h = im.size
    px = im.load()
    def g(x,y):
        p=px[x,y]
        return (p[0]+p[1]+p[2])/3
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    blobs=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if seen[y][x] or g(x,y) >= dark_thresh:
                continue
            q=deque([(x,y)])
            seen[y][x]=True
            pts=[(x,y)]
            border=False
            while q:
                cx,cy=q.popleft()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=cx+dx,cy+dy
                    if nx<0 or ny<0 or nx>=w or ny>=h:
                        border=True
                        continue
                    if not seen[ny][nx] and g(nx,ny)<dark_thresh:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True
                        q.append((nx,ny))
                        pts.append((nx,ny))
            if min_size <= len(pts) <= max_size and not border:
                xs=[p[0] for p in pts]; ys=[p[1] for p in pts]
                blobs.append((round(sum(xs)/len(xs),2), round(sum(ys)/len(ys),2), len(pts), max(xs)-min(xs), max(ys)-min(ys)))
